complete metadata/template/output parity pending; rc91 metadata-extractor name/cleanName/multiplier port and occurrence-based source group/provider context; local Node oracle only; not billing; rc93 raster icon upload reimplemented with bounded PNG/JPEG decode and canonical PNG, no SVG/remote image; rc94 github-proxy-handler / PublicProfilesView version UX adapted to fixed-host Go metadata request, enabled catalog lookup, Redis shared cache and lease, explicit unknown on failure, no download or user credentials; rc96 bounded official GitHub repository rename redirects; rc97 AnnouncementCard UX adapted to public-page title/type/dismissible content revisions, pure text and visible browser preference failure; global announcement distribution pending; rc99 AnnouncementSettings global audience distribution adapted to explicit authenticated/public publication with reauth/CAS and shared React UIAble notice; plaintext only, original restricted rich text still tracked; rc100 AnnouncementCard restricted markup adapted to Go validated node tree and React allowlisted rendering, stricter quoted attributes/HTTPS links/no class, rejects unsupported markup instead of silently stripping; rc101 GroupManagementModal/useManualNodes group rename, dissolve-to-ungrouped and persistent group order adapted to React UIAble with native drag + accessible move buttons, Go owned-table transaction/snapshot guard, existing-name merge explicitly rejected; rc104 ProfileCard/MySubscriptionsView draft ordering and output workflow adapted to React UIAble cards, exact-membership Go transaction and eight actual preview/copy/download targets; original global token sharing deliberately separated into explicit publication contract; rc105 ProfileCard copy/QR/access-log workflow safely reimplemented as explicit administrator reauthenticated expiring encrypted snapshots, separate from user subscription grants and upstream global token; snapshots replace automatic global public inventory; rc106 PublicProfiles/ProfileCard subscription directory adapted to explicit per-page publication generation binding, separate admin reauth/CAS; token-free anonymous metadata and validated snapshot downloads, no implicit inventory disclosure; rc108 GlobalSettings defaultOperators fallback adapted to shared Go profile resolver and existing React OperatorEditor; empty independent chain fallback, explicit skip option, admin reauth/CAS and fail-closed reads; prefix/region overrides still pending; rc109 GlobalSettings prefix and region override workflow adapted to React UIAble; name-only prefix with group inheritance, bounded RE2 first match for automatic template regions; legacy output defaults remain disabled explicitly documented; rc110 GuestbookModal/GuestbookManagement/guestbook-handler workflow migrated to per-page Go transactions and React UIAble, default disabled/audit, real anonymous setting enforcement, fixed status/actions, public projection, bounded pagination/rate and owned deletion; Telegram independent; B1 Snell/WireGuard URI, Clash and strict INI adaptation; modern sing-box WireGuard endpoint output; unchanged url-to-clash.js copied solely as local pinned oracle, no server JavaScript runtime

template_reference: MiSub 4952c16: template-model.js, template-pipeline.js and render-singbox.js/render-egern.js copied unchanged to third_party/misub/reference. Go bounded templates cover groups, ordered local rules, encrypted DNS and explicit HTTPS remote rule-set declarations (Clash yaml/text; sing-box source/binary). Credential-bearing URLs and arbitrary paths reject. Full renderer and preset parity pending. Explicit region/protocol automatic groups use the pinned geo-utils metadata; only authorized links expand; name collisions preserve existing groups.
ini_reference: MiSub 4952c16: builtin-surge-generator.js, builtin-loon-generator.js and builtin-quanx-generator.js copied unchanged, MIT. Node mapper functions exercised by local vm-only oracle (never on application server). 17 conversions compared ignoring decorative remote icons; unsupported fields and incompatible protocols reject. Commercial clients not yet validated.
distribution: Preserve notices and corresponding modified source. Review LGPL obligations before publishing binaries. Locked Go and pnpm dependencies are part of source distribution.
public_page_reference: MiSub 4952c16 src/views/PublicProfilesView.vue and components/public/ProfileCard.vue: hero, announcement, card grid and share interaction reference. Reimplemented in React + UIAble without Vue runtime. Security adaptation: directory only selects explicitly published text pages; no private inventory/token/anonymous subscription export, guestbook or executable custom renderer. Full migration still pending.
ini_import_reference: MiSub 4952c16 functions/modules/utils/node-parser.js parseSurgeOrQxLine adapted to internal/subscription/inventory_ini.go (MIT). Strict options/quotes/conflicts; only local proxy sections imported; rules/policies not applied; unknown protocols/options reject. 19 existing Go renderer roundtrips; full upstream parser parity and commercial clients pending.
source_name_options_reference: MiSub 4952c16 functions/modules/utils/node-cleaner.js copied unchanged (MIT), local vm oracle only. Go URI fragment plusAsSpace opt-in preserves credentials/query/%2B and structured/VMess names; deliberately no repeated percent decoding. 8 fixed-source name comparisons; full source-filter/metadata parity pending.
source_filters_reference: MiSub 4952c16 node-cleaner.js parseFilterRuleText/buildRuleSet/filterNodeUrls/applyFilterRules; unchanged fixed reference, local vm oracle. 24 filter combinations compared. Go strict RE2/limits/unknown protocol rejection; VMess decoded names instead of missing fragment URL. React UIAble visual keyword/protocol/preset chips and advanced text; no Vue runtime.
session_directory_reference: Sub2API fixed user/account security interaction and existing MiGate session identity. React + UIAble shared paged directory for self/admin; stable sort, IP search, scoped self revocation. Go implementation original, reuses existing Redis sessions; no authentication policy reduction. Legacy no-page response preserved. Bounded full Redis scan remains a scale limitation.
loon_wireguard_reference: MiSub 4952c16 render-loon.js copied unchanged (MIT), local Node VM comparison only. Go bounded nested peer grammar preserves dual-stack, DNS, PSK, allowed IPs, MTU and reserved; old builtin subset compatible, keepalive and excess DNS explicitly refused. No commercial Loon device claim.
outbound_pool_tools_reference: MiGate fixed OutboundsPage / ProxyPoolModal and outbound_subscriptions: manual full-snapshot order, pool display priority/prepend, explicit armed auto materialization, per-pool refresh results. Public SOCKS/HTTP/HTTPS directory uses only fixed official EDT-Pages GitHub paths (replacing the third-party mirror); bounded encrypted metadata cache. TCP-only Agent probe validates committed inventory/public numeric IP, pins DNS, never arbitrary commands or throughput claims.
